records.context: Call before the panel is destroyed so a running QThread keeps an owner. The active stream's thread is passed to the drain helper with a 3000 ms wait and each retired thread with a 1000 ms wait. Threads still running after those waits are parked by the helper rather than terminated; this method does not guarantee that every thread has exited when it returns.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.ai_chat_panel.AIChatPanel.shutdown#1
records.source: Call before the panel is destroyed so a running QThread keeps an owner. The active stream's thread is passed to the drain helper with a 3000 ms wait and each retired thread with a 1000 ms wait. Threads still running after those waits are parked by the helper rather than terminated; this method does not guarantee that every thread has exited when it returns.
records.translation: Anropa före panelens förstörelse så att en körande QThread behåller en ägare. Den aktiva strömmens tråd skickas till dräneringshjälpen med 3000 ms väntetid och varje tidigare tråd med 1000 ms väntetid. Trådar som fortfarande körs efter dessa väntetider parkeras av hjälpen i stället för att tvångsavslutas; metoden garanterar inte att alla trådar har avslutats när den returnerar.

records.context: The pointer arguments are not optional in practice. The worker passes all ten positionally to whichever engine the pattern chose, and this signature stopped at six -- so every frame raised TypeError, the failure signal fired, no image ever arrived, and the widget painted its fallback colour. That is why the CPU cascade was black while the GPU one was fine and the CPU orbit followed the mouse.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.fractal_cascade.CascadeEngine.render#1
records.source: THE POINTER ARGUMENTS ARE NOT OPTIONAL IN PRACTICE. The worker passes all ten positionally to whichever engine the pattern chose, and this signature stopped at six -- so every frame raised TypeError, the failure signal fired, no image ever arrived, and the widget painted its fallback colour. That is why the CPU cascade was black while the GPU one was fine and the CPU orbit followed the mouse.
records.translation: PEKARARGUMENTEN ÄR INTE VALFRIA I PRAKTIKEN. Arbetaren skickar alla tio som positionsargument till den motor som mönstret valde, men den här signaturen slutade vid sex -- därför utlöste varje bildruta TypeError, felsignalen skickades, ingen bild anlände och widgeten målade sin reservfärg. Därför var CPU-kaskaden svart medan GPU-versionen fungerade och CPU-omloppsmönstret följde musen.

records.translation: En bild av typen ``uint8`` behåller sina kanalvärden när den konverteras till RGB: gråskala upprepas i tre kanaler, extra kanaler efter de tre första tas bort och saknade kanaler fylls med nollor. records.context: The centralized :func:`spacr.qt.setup_screen.should_open` check compares the answered setup version with the running version. :func:`spacr.qt.terms.needs_agreement` additionally requests setup when the terms have never been accepted or have changed since acceptance.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.setup_slides.open_setup_if_needed#1
records.source: The centralized :func:`spacr.qt.setup_screen.should_open` check compares the answered setup version with the running version. :func:`spacr.qt.terms.needs_agreement` additionally requests setup when the terms have never been accepted or have changed since acceptance.
records.translation: Den centrala kontrollen :func:`spacr.qt.setup_screen.should_open` jämför den inställningsversion som har besvarats med den version som körs. :func:`spacr.qt.terms.needs_agreement` begär dessutom inställningar om villkoren aldrig har accepterats eller har ändrats sedan de accepterades.

review_method: AI technical authoring and independent AI technical/language peer review against exact widget implementations and source/context bindings. Only demonstrated contract and companion-translation defects changed. No human or native-speaker signoff.
